\begin{lemma}[Exponential code bound]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.code_le_gKv}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.code_le_gKv}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.lgv, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.logSpace_le_size_succ, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gev, Complexity.logSpace}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet, let $x$
be a finite Boolean word, and let $E,s\in\mathbb N$. Write $\kappa(N)$ for the code
bound associated to $N$, and let $\ell(n)=\lfloor\log_2 n\rfloor+1$ and
$v(n)=\operatorname{size}(n)+1$. If $\kappa(N)\le E$, then
$2^{\kappa(N)(s+\ell(|x|)+1)}\le 2^{2E v(|x|)+2Es}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[Monotonicity of the exponential bound]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv_mono}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv_mono}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gev}
\difficulty{2}
For natural numbers $E,\ell,s,s'$, if $s\le s'$, then $2^{2E\ell+2Es}\le
2^{2E\ell+2Es'}$.
\end{lemma}

\begin{lemma}[A lower bound for an exponential quantity]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.lt_gKv}

\begin{theorem}[Correctness of the counting loop]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.loop_run}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.loop_run}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.StepRel, Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.ExpBFS.card_rset_succ_of_le, Complexity.ExpBFS.rset, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.AccO, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.InitO, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.Mem.lt, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.RelO, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St.Bd, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St.Clear, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.lgv, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.mem_ball, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.AccM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.IG, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.InitM, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.card_ball_eq_rset, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.card_ball_zero_code, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.cmp_run, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.code_le_gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv_mono, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.iter_run, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.lt_gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_iff_exists_acc_of_card_eq, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.mem_of_exists_acc, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.noAcc_balls_iff, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.one_le_card_rset, Complexity.LogProg.NSem.congr, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.accO_orcN, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.initO_orcN, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.orcN, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.rel_orcN, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace}
\difficulty{6}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input, let $L$ be a
language of Boolean strings, and let $sp:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$ be such that $N$
decides $L$ using space at most $sp(|x|)$. For a Boolean string $x$, let
$E,B\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy $\mathrm{codeK}(N)\le E$, $1\le E$, and
$2^{2E\,\mathrm{lgv}(|x|)+2E(sp(|x|)+1)}+1\le B$. Suppose $d,s\in\mathbb{N}$ satisfy
$sp(|x|)+1-s=d$ and $s\le sp(|x|)+1$, and let $\sigma$ be a counting state whose radius
is $s$, whose halving count is $\mathrm{lgv}(|x|)$, whose exponent is zero, whose
registers $g,cur,stp,u,cnt$ are zero, and whose registers are all at most $B$. Assume
either $s=0$ and $\sigma.n=0$, or $1\le s$ and $\sigma.n$ is the number of codes below
$2^{\mathrm{codeK}(N)(s+\mathrm{logSpace}(|x|)+1)}$ reachable from the initial
configuration code by zero or more valid steps within the space window of radius $s-1$.
Then, from the round state with false phase and $E$ rounds remaining, the counting
program terminates on every computation branch, keeps every register at most $B$
whenever it is live, and has an accepting branch if and only if $x\notin L$.
\end{theorem}

\begin{theorem}[Generator initialization decides the complement]
\lean{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gen_start}
\label{Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gen_start}
\leanok
\uses{Complexity.Codec.codeK, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St.Bd, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St.Clear, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.St.zero, Complexity.LogProg.ISCount.lgv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.IG, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gKv, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.gev, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.loop_run, Complexity.LogProg.ISGen.start_run, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.decs, Complexity.LogProg.SavitchARM.orcN, Complexity.indicator_indexLang_pairEncode, Complexity.inputLenLang, Turing.FinNDTM.DecidesInSpace, Turing.pairEncode}
\difficulty{4}
Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean input symbols, let $L$
be a language of Boolean words, let $sp:\mathbb N\to\mathbb N$, and let $x$ be a Boolean
word. Suppose $N$ decides $L$ using space at most $sp(n)$ on inputs of length $n$. For
natural numbers $E$ and $B$, suppose the code bound of $N$ is at most $E$, $1\le E$, and
$2^{2E(\operatorname{size}(|x|)+1)+2E(sp(|x|)+1)}+1\le B$. Then, starting the generator
in its scanning state with all registers zero, every computation branch terminates,
every register stays at most $B$ before halting, and some branch accepts if and only if
$x\notin L$.
\end{theorem}

\difficulty{3}

Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $S(n)$ work-tape cells on inputs of

\begin{theorem}[Complement closure of nondeterministic log space]

\leanok

For every language $L$ over the binary alphabet, if $L$ is decidable by a finite
nondeterministic Turing machine using at most a constant multiple of $\log_2(n)+1$
